instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Digital marketing agency specializing in social media strategy, influencer campaign management, and content production for lifestyle, beauty, and fashion brands. Team of 35 creatives and strategists managing 25 active client accounts. Seeking to implement AI-powered content performance prediction and automated A/B creative testing. We operate across multiple locations and have distinct functional leadership for operations, commercial, finance, and technology. Our annual planning process is well-established but can be rigid — mid-cycle innovation funding requires navigating a formal business case approval chain involving 3-4 stakeholders.
answers.pastInitiatives: We successfully deployed a new CRM system across the sales team 18 months ago, which improved lead tracking and reduced pipeline data entry time by 30%. The implementation was well-planned with dedicated project management and training. Building on this success, we are now exploring marketing automation integration and AI-assisted lead scoring.
answers.strategicGoals: Growth is our existential mandate. We are losing market share to faster-moving competitors and need to reignite our growth trajectory. We are willing to make significant strategic bets — potentially including M&A, new product lines, or geographic expansion — provided they have a credible path to meaningful revenue contribution within 18 months.
answers.teamSize: Our R&D function consists of 10-12 engineers organized into two squads: one focused on core product innovation and one on exploratory/new business model prototyping. We also have 2 dedicated data engineers building our analytics infrastructure. Innovation projects follow a lean startup methodology with clear go/no-go criteria at 3-month checkpoints.
answers.additionalContext: We are 3 months into fundraising conversations with growth equity investors who are conducting deep due diligence on our technology and operations. Their feedback indicates concern about our digital maturity relative to peers. We need to quickly identify and launch 2-3 innovation initiatives that will address these concerns and strengthen our fundraising narrative.

input.changes_since_last: Restructured leadership team. 8 legacy processes automated. Exploring new revenue streams.

opportunities.title: Scale AI-Powered Content Performance Prediction Engine (Carry Forward)
opportunities.rationale: The initial exploration of AI prediction needs to move beyond POC into a scalable, repeatable product offering for core client services. This strengthens the value proposition and addresses functional automation interests. It is crucial for improving operational efficiency while satisfying due diligence requirements.

first_actions: Define minimum viable feature set (MVFS) for AI prediction model targeting 2-3 key client verticals.
Integrate the model output directly into existing CRM/Project Management tools to ensure immediate usability by strategists.
Develop internal metrics dashboard tracking predicted vs. actual campaign performance.
resources_needed: Operational buy-in from senior client account managers
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieving a minimum 80% predictive accuracy rate on campaign performance for pilot clients.
milestones: Successful integration and internal testing with 2 active accounts (6 months)
Pilot launch revenue contribution identified (9 months)

opportunities.title: Establish Cross-Sector B2B AI Service Line (New)
opportunities.rationale: Given the 'bold' risk appetite and immediate need to impress growth investors, establishing a new revenue stream beyond current digital marketing services is critical. Focusing on adjacent high-growth sectors (e.g., HealthTech or FinTech content) de-risks market concentration and demonstrates scalable expansion capability.

first_actions: Conduct rapid feasibility studies with existing R&D team to identify 2 target non-entertainment industries.
Develop a core service package (e.g., AI compliance content auditing) tailored for the selected sector.
Draft an initial partnership playbook focusing on industry accelerators or VC introductions.
resources_needed: Seed funding allocation for market validation
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure 1 Letter of Intent (LOI) from a non-traditional industry client within 6 months.
milestones: Sector selection and initial SME alignment (2 months)
Service package beta testing with a friendly organization (4 months)
Pitch deck finalized for investment/partnership review (7 months)

next_steps.action: Formalize the AI roadmap and dedicated data science sprint plan to ensure continuous progress on Opp 2.
Streamline the formal business case approval process by creating a 'Fast Track Innovation' council with clear decision rights, bypassing rigid stakeholders for pre-approved funds.
Compile a detailed 'Investor Readiness' deck focusing on the technology architecture, measurable KPIs (AI accuracy), and risk mitigation plans.

key_weaknesses: High dependency on formal sign-off processes ('Time' barrier) that stifle mid-cycle innovation velocity.
Limited established market presence in non-entertainment verticals, requiring significant effort to validate new service lines.
Digital maturity gap perception relative to high-growth peers, necessitating immediate, demonstrable technological progress for fundraising.

improvements: Successful restructuring of the leadership team and automation of 8 legacy processes has improved operational efficiency and governance structure.
The established lean startup methodology provides excellent guardrails for rapid prototyping and objective checkpointing.
persistent_gaps: Translating internal process improvements into compelling, externally quantifiable growth narratives (i.e., linking automation cost savings to new market capture).
Maintaining focus on the core digital marketing strength while simultaneously building out a radical new business line.
achieved_milestones: Successful deployment of CRM system 18 months ago provides foundational data integrity and process discipline.
Internal functional leadership structures are defined, allowing for targeted process automation efforts.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: The company has matured from initial exploration to active execution planning (evidenced by restructuring and automation). The focus has sharpened toward AI integration and high-stakes growth initiatives driven by external fundraising pressure.
